2607.14871.title: Asymmetric Peak-Aware Loss for Peak-Critical Time Series Forecasting
2607.14871.paper_summary: In many operational time-series forecasting applications, such as crowd demand forecasting, the risk related to under-prediction is substantially higher than that of over-prediction. Accurate prediction of rare demand spikes plays a critical role in downstream tasks. Yet most time-series forecasters are trained with symmetric objectives (e.g., MSE, MAE) and evaluated primarily on aggregate error, which can mask failures in extreme-values and peak-timing predictions. We introduce Asymmetric Peak-Aware Loss (APAL), a simple, model-agnostic objective that (i) penalizes under-predictions more heavily and (ii) increases the training weight of peak regions within each forecast window. We further propose a peak-critical evaluation protocol that complements MAE/MSE with channel-wise tail error (Top-10% and Top-1%) and peak metrics (precision, recall, F1 under timing tolerance, and peak timing error). We evaluate APAL on long-horizon multivariate forecasting across five state-of-the-art backbones, with a focus on pedestrian demand forecasting using (i) a production-ready subset of the City of Melbourne pedestrian hourly count dataset and (ii) a beach visitor count dataset. The generality of the loss function for time-series forecasting is tested on additional benchmarks. Across peak-critical datasets and settings, APAL improves tail accuracy and peak-prediction quality while exposing a controllable trade-off with aggregate error, making it a practical solution when peak-prediction failures are the dominant operational concern.
2607.14871.paper_summary_zh: 在許多運營時間序列預測應用中，例如人潮需求預測，與低估預測相關的風險遠高於高估預測的風險。準確預測稀有需求高峰在下游任務中扮演著關鍵角色。然而，大多數時間序列預測模型都是以對稱目標（例如，MSE，MAE）進行訓練，並主要根據總體誤差進行評估，這可能掩蓋了在極端值和高峰時間預測中的失敗。我們引入了不對稱高峰感知損失（APAL），這是一個簡單的模型無關目標，它（i）對低估預測施加更重的懲罰，並且（ii）增加每個預測窗口內高峰區域的訓練權重。我們進一步提出了一個高峰關鍵評估協議，該協議通過通道級尾部誤差（前10%和前1%）和高峰指標（精確度、召回率、在時間容忍下的F1和高峰時間誤差）來補充MAE/MSE。我們在五個最先進的骨幹上評估APAL，專注於使用（i）墨爾本市行人每小時計數數據集的生產就緒子集和（ii）海灘訪客計數數據集的人行需求預測進行長期多變量預測。損失函數在時間序列預測中的通用性在其他基準上進行了測試。在高峰關鍵數據集和設置中，APAL提高了尾部準確性和高峰預測質量，同時揭示了與總體誤差之間可控的權衡，使其成為當高峰預測失敗是主要運營關注時的實用解決方案。
